requests.reply: {"translations": ["In the early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.", "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?"]}
{"translations": ["I brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["A crack appeared in the ward again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night."]}

{"translations": ["Before the words had even finished falling, Wanqi Jing came rushing up from the bottom of the mountain.", "Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain"]}
{"translations": ["Hurry, carry her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills."]}
{"translations": ["Manqi Jing rushed into the main hall carrying the unconscious woman on his back, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The injury isn't serious, she's just exhausted her spiritual power. Just give her a Spirit Recovery Pill."]}
{"translations": ["Shijie Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward; Shixiong Wanqi and I are here.", "Alright. Once Miss Qiu wakes up, come call me immediately."]}
{"translations": ["Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Xie Xuan stood at the entrance of the hall, her sword still in its scabbard, but the lamplight flickered for a moment."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin, I hope you have been well. I am here on the Pavilion Master's orders to collect thirty percent of the qi stones."]}

{"translations": ["Thirty percent? The qi stones were painstakingly saved by the sect; since when is it the turn of outsiders to take them?", "The ward is already cracked; it is not safe to keep the qi stones in your hands. I will return in three days."]}
{"translations": ["Xie Xuan gave a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without even looking back."]}
{"translations": ["To say three days means three days, I never break my word."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the couch."]}
{"translations": ["Elder, let me go guard the ward. Miss Chou is being looked after by Yue Chuan, so I can leave.", "Finally, [he] nodded and took out a jade talisman from his sleeve."]}
{"translations": ["This is the Array Eye Command. Only by protecting it can you protect your Dao."]}
{"translations": ["Yue Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms, then whispered a few more instructions."]}
{"translations": ["At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.", "Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Chou is awake; please convey my thanks to her."]}
{"translations": ["Shan Yunzhou nodded and kept the formation eye token close to his person."]}
{"translations": ["In the hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["It's good that you're awake. You've been unconscious all day, don't move around too much ▼"]}
{"translations": ["Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky through the window.", "Unnoticed by anyone, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Shijie Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward; Shixiong Wanqi and I are here.
translations.11: Alright. Once Miss Qiu wakes up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: Wanqi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xie Xuan stood at the entrance of the hall, her sword still in its scabbard, but the lamplight flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, I hope you have been well. I am here on the Pavilion Master's orders to collect thirty percent of the qi stones.
translations.15: Thirty percent? The qi stones were painstakingly saved by the sect; since when is it the turn of outsiders to take them?
translations.16: The ward is already cracked; it is not safe to keep the qi stones in your hands. I will return in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan gave a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without even looking back.
translations.18: To say three days means three days, I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the ward. Miss Chou is being looked after by Yue Chuan, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, [he] nodded and took out a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Array Eye Command. Only by protecting it can you protect your Dao.
translations.23: Yue Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms, then whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Chou is awake; please convey my thanks to her.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and kept the formation eye token close to his person.
translations.27: In the hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You've been unconscious all day, don't move around too much ▼
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky through the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed by anyone, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: A crack appeared in the ward again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night.
translations.5: Before the words had even finished falling, Wanqi Jing came rushing up from the bottom of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain
translations.7: Hurry, carry her up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
translations.8: Manqi Jing rushed into the main hall carrying the unconscious woman on his back, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: The injury isn't serious, she's just exhausted her spiritual power. Just give her a Spirit Recovery Pill.
